commit.message:
Upgrade Stabilizer pass/runtime for LLVM 19

* refresh intrinsics lowering (new header, libcall mappings, pass updates)
* sync runtime Function/Context helpers and libstabilizer with new ABI
* relocate SPEC benchmarks under tests/integration with new makefiles
* update build/tooling configs (.gitignore, common.mk, szc, szclo.cfg)
